posts.title: Too old for this shit
posts.description: Not too long ago, I used to look at postings for some roles where there was an element of ageism to the employment conditions. Lots of references to “young” and “energetic”, and so on and so forth. That irritated me. posts.title: Noise
posts.description: Everything around us is noise. If you watch the news, or popular late night chat shows, you'll note that the sole aim is to sow seeds of division. You glean nothing of value from these sources, except a sense that the world is fucked, and there is no hope left. It's not just news. It's work, and it's everywhere.
